description: This file defines the SavePerformanceTrackerController class, which manages the rendering logic for the performance tracker save and edit components within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and dynamically sets which Vue component to render based on request attributes.

classes.name: SavePerformanceTrackerController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing the appropriate Vue component ('performance-tracker-edit' or 'performance-tracker-save') based on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request, used in the OrangeHRM Performance module.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets the Vue component to be rendered depending on whether a performance tracker 'id' is provided in the request attributes.
